productConcept.name: Lōmen — Precision Acoustic Modeling Platform
productConcept.tagline: Model the room. Before you build it.
productConcept.description: Browser-native acoustic modeling platform for recording engineers, studio designers, architectural acousticians, and broadcast facility teams — RT60 prediction, modal analysis, SBIR, and material specification in one environment.
productConcept.rationale: The quill-amber palette (warm cream #f2efe9, charcoal #3d3930, orange accent #fb7339) suggests precision instrumentation combined with editorial warmth — neither pure tech-cold nor purely artisan. This points toward a tool used by specialists who combine scientific rigor with craft. Acoustic modeling is a domain where published science (Sabine, Eyring, ISO 354, ISO 3382) meets practical craft decisions, making Lōmen a natural fit that avoids the cliché warm-palette outcomes (food, fashion, lifestyle).

animationDecision: motion-tokens — quill-amber motion system has spring easing (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), durations at 0.33s/0.44s/0.66s/0.88s, and concept_by_video.md references scroll animation patterns. Non-standard GSAP techniques deployed: stroke-dashoffset SVG path drawing (waveform), per-character scramble (hero headline), clip-path morphing wipes, element assembly from scattered positions, parallax depth, scroll-triggered counter animations.
